## Why Sahoo is running for Mayor of Milpitas?
READ: Sahoo brings “wild card” energy to Milpitas Mayor race. - Milpitas Beats
Milpitas deserves a mayor who listens, acts, and delivers measurable results for residents, families, small businesses, and neighborhoods with transparency.
Milpitas is home. Residents deserve a city government that protects public safety, invests in infrastructure, manages sustainable growth, grows our economy, is accountable to residents, and improves everyday quality of life.
Change. Transparency. Trust.
A practical approach to making city government more transparent, responsive, and accountable to residents.
Campaign Priorities
## Priorities for Milpitas
A focused agenda built around public safety, infrastructure, sustainable growth, growing our economy, accountable government, and a better quality of life.
01
### Public Safety
Support fully-funded police and emergency services, effective public safety partnerships, and emergency preparedness. Improve dangerous intersections, pedestrian and bicycle safety, traffic management, and speeding enforcement for a safer, more responsive Milpitas.
02
### Infrastructure
Prioritize roads, public facilities, parks, utilities, and infrastructure projects that improve everyday life across Milpitas.
03
### Sustainable Growth
Growth should be accompanied by thoughtful traffic planning, infrastructure, utilities, parks, schools coordination, and protections for established neighborhoods.
04
### Grow our economy
Strengthen Milpitas as a business and technology hub. We should support local small businesses, encourage entrepreneurship, attract responsible investment, and create opportunities for quality jobs.
05
### Accountable Government
Connect public spending and city projects to clear goals, measurable outcomes, and understandable information for residents. Make budgets, project timelines, permits, and city decisions easier for residents to understand and track. Let's deliver on our commitments.
06
### Quality of Life
Prioritize responsive city services, well-maintained parks and roads, clean neighborhoods, and affordability. Balance growth with the services and neighborhood character that make Milpitas a great place to live, work, and raise a family.
Vision for Milpitas
## Milpitas City-hall that works for residents.
My focus is simple: public safety, infrastructure, sustainable growth, a growing economy, accountable government, and a better quality of life for Milpitas residents.
The city's growth should improve everyday life for residents. That means coordinating development with infrastructure, transportation, public safety, parks, neighborhoods, and long-term financial planning.
01
### Finish What We Start
Set realistic timelines, remove obstacles, and deliver infrastructure and city projects residents can see.
02
### Better Coordination
Improve coordination with schools, transportation agencies, neighboring cities, and regional partners.
03
### Clear Information
Give residents clearer information about budgets, projects, timelines, and city performance.
04
### Responsive City Hall
Make city services easier to access and more responsive to residents and neighborhoods.
Fiscal Responsibility
## Responsible budgeting for Milpitas
Public dollars should be connected to clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and long-term financial stability. Here is My Plan
### Fund What Matters
Protect core services including public safety, infrastructure, emergency response, parks, and neighborhood maintenance.
### Plan Ahead
Address long-term budget pressures through disciplined planning, reserves, and realistic project timelines.
### Show the Work
Make spending, contracts, project status, and outcomes understandable to residents.
## Campaign message
Change. Transparency. Trust.
Milpitas deserves transparent government and responsible leadership residents can trust.
